rubric.role_summary: Hands-on AI engineering role building and deploying agents and automation for B2B SaaS sales, customer success, renewals, and retention across portfolio companies.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Hands-on AI engineering role building and deploying agents and automation for B2B SaaS sales, customer success, renewals, and retention across portfolio companies.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Hands-on experience building AI agents, LLM-powered workflows, or intelligent automation systems in production.
- Hands-on experience building and shipping production systems.
- Familiarity with the B2B SaaS revenue tech stack, such as Salesforce or an equivalent CRM.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Prefers individual-contributor work.
- Personally build and ship production systems rather than direct others to do the work.
- Real-world application of AI to improve revenue in a commercial business and extensive knowledge of primary AI platforms.
- Deep familiarity with the B2B SaaS revenue tech stack: Salesforce or an equivalent CRM, revenue intelligence tools, CPQ, and customer success platforms.
- Experience building pipeline dashboards, renewal forecasts, and retention analytics.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
